# Design System & UI/UX Guidelines
- For UI/UX tasks, read and follow the skill at `.opencode/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md`.
- Maintain strict padding, typography scale, and light-theme contrast tokens (`#6C63FF` primary, `#F8F8FC` background).
- Avoid anti-patterns: AI pink/purple gradients, missing cursor states, and unrounded card borders.
